title: Odd parity factorization
statement: Let $k$ be a nonnegative integer and let $C$ be a sign-query check on $2k+1$ coordinates whose predicate accepts exactly when the product of its three input signs equals some fixed sign. The signed value of $C$ on the parity of all $2k+1$ coordinates equals the product, over all coordinates $i$, of its signed values on the individual coordinate functions.
hypotheses_covered: C is a sign-query check on 2k+1 coordinates
C's predicate belongs to the family of predicates accepting when the product of three signs equals a fixed sign
